name: Jeff Krasno
reason: Commune's co-founder and podcast host rather than a teacher, and his own writing carries partisan political commentary (Substack 'Middle Way' essays such as 'What Made America Great', Sept 2026, critical of the Trump administration and MAGA, and 'The Political Fault Line' on politics and COVID); much of the rest is health-framed (Good Stress book and summit sold on reversing his diabetes and weight loss, The Comfort Trap, GLP-1 and gut episodes). He is not anti-vaccine: his recent episodes debunk the 82% miscarriage claim and the MMR-autism link. Only Stoic Meditations and a couple of older books would stand.
